title: Date field extraction answer
description: Structured-decoding contract for a paper_facts date field (sample_start, sample_end). The model returns the date as stated, normalised to YYYY-MM, plus a verbatim supporting quote, OR reports the paper silent. paper_facts (schema v1.1) are analysis-only extraction output: RQ1-scorable, and the adapter NEVER reads them (Guard 2).

value.description: The stated date normalised to YYYY-MM (month zero-padded), or null when answered=false. A year alone is not a valid value -- the paper is silent on the month.

quote.description: Verbatim span supporting the value; required when answered=true.
